fuse_model_convbnrelu: fuse Conv-BN-ReLU modules in a PyTorch model for quantization with optional QAT and FX support
fuse_model_fx_graph: fuse a PyTorch model using Torch FX symbolic tracing and graph-based module fusion
fuse_model_qat_fx: fuse a PyTorch model with quantization-aware training using Torch FX graph tracing
swap_modules_deepcopy: deep copy a model and swap custom batch norm and conv modules to standard PyTorch types
check_bn_exist_model: check if a PyTorch model contains any BatchNorm layers and return a boolean result
